authority.ordinary_actors: anonymous WebSocket connections; no transport operator token
authority.chat_capability: explicit valid server-issued chat_token permits resumption; record only token digest/presence
authority.transport_operator: valid configured/bootstrap transport token has instance authority; not an ordinary-B negative
authority.signed_media_url: valid signed URL is a bearer capability; intentional possession may authorize byte fetch. Tamper/traversal negatives remain mandatory product tests; not a no-token path-guess success criterion

verdicts.pass: complete grounded two-turn D chain plus all applicable isolation, ownership, byte-integrity, termination and cleanup checks
verdicts.product_fail: Complete trustworthy observation of wrong answer, cross-chat disclosure/unauthorized file open, accepted forged identity, changed fixture, or observable product resources failing to settle. Missing required final/terminal is product_fail only after complete actual wire collection with an explicit bounded observation window.
verdicts.invalid: Collector/instrumentation error, missing or mismatched source/wire/actor/session/request evidence, ungrounded scripted answer, forged or incomplete trace. Driver/collector close, artifact persistence or temporary-directory ACL failure is invalid or separate engineering failure. Never convert absent evidence into product pass/fail.

separation.scripted_provider: D control only; every response is guarded by actual current messages/tool outcome
separation.R: reject before allocating output, transport or provider; no R precondition, budget or eligibility inferred
separation.legacy_v1: unchanged; obsolete nine engineering assertions mapped explicitly, not inverted or treated as current acceptance requirements
separation.historical_results: unchanged; new D does not regrade old trials or repair the old remote CI result
